description: A high-performance, lightweight Entity Component System (ECS) for C#. Archetype and chunk based storage, source-generated ForEach queries, inline component buffers, tags, change filters, multithreaded query execution, SIMD-friendly handles and command buffers — with zero external dependencies on .NET 8.
releaseNotes: 3.8.0: structural changes are 1.6-3.3x faster - every Create overload, Clone, Add/Remove moves, Destroy, and CommandBuffer recording and Commit (CommandBuffer creates are about 3x faster and allocate about 60% less); Clone copies the source entity even when allocating the clone's id grows the entity map; Move(entity, signature) defaults the components it adds instead of keeping a previous occupant's values; a CommandBuffer reused after Clear, or after Set and Destroy on the same entity, keeps every entity's buffered values apart; CommandBuffer.Create with three or more buffer components keeps every buffer; EntityDatabase.Dispose and TrimExcess free archetype chunk memory; buffered dynamic buffers that are cancelled or never applied release their heap memory. 3.7.2: Clear forgets ids recycled by earlier destroys - entities created after a Clear start again from id 0 and are found by id. 3.7.1: an entity that loses a managed component keeps the remaining managed components paired with their own data - Remove/AddAndRemove no longer throw ArrayTypeMismatchException or copy a neighbouring component's value. 3.7.0: ParallelJobRunner signals only the workers a call needs (a one-job call never leaves the calling thread), runs jobs a worker hasn't started on the caller, and parks idle workers instead of spinning - more threads than cores no longer costs milliseconds per parallel call; parallel queries claim chunks from one shared list (a preempted thread no longer stalls the join) and are allocation-free in steady state; UntrackedWriteHandle and Chunk.MarkChanged<T>() to write tracked components without marking every chunk; generated ForEach/ForEachChunk honour change filters; a destroy carries the moved entity's pending changes; chunks past 32 KB keep their columns apart (int offsets); fresh entity ids start at version 0; a stale EntityData throws instead of reaching another archetype (chunk arrays are no longer pooled); EntityDatabase() and EntityDatabaseOptions.Default; TrimExcess on an empty database. 3.6.0: parallel queries execute one fork/join across all matching archetypes (was one per archetype); Archetype.Reserve zero-initializes unmanaged chunk memory.
title: EntitiesDb
